correctness.rationale: Exact quadratic discriminant is strictly positive, forcing stationary rays; angular Hessians rule out positive-ray maxima. The negative-ray stationarity equation gives a polynomial with four sign changes, hence at most two radial maxima per ray. The n=11 exact rational signs and n>=12 B_n extremal construction prove attainability; all roots in saturating examples are simple and have negative definite Hessians.
